text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය
අති විෙශෂ
No. 1943/5 – MONDAY, NOVEMBER 30, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: MTR/LND/ACQUI/LZ/3958. Land Ministry’s Reference No.: 1/3/J/68/69/81/VE. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose: Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired:

02. The below mentioned land depicted as Lot No. 02 in preliminary Plan No. MR 729, located in Kekanadura-East Grama Niladhari Division of Matara Divisional Secretariat Division, Matara District, Southern Province, has been acquired for the Matara Kirala Kele Project. Schedule 1. Lot No. 02 Name of land: Modara Keke; Nature of land: faddy field; Name of the Original: Gunadasa Kulasamanayake; Owner of the Land: No. 89, Light house Road, Dondra; Extent of the Land: 7 acres, 17 Perches 13 roods. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands* on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Matara Divisional Secretariat on the 18th day of December 2015, at 10.30 a.m. and are hereby

requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 11th Day of December, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for the acquisition of the said land/servitude*, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. RANJITH YAPA, Divisional Secretary, Matara.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Matara. 20th November, 2015.
